name: TestFontDroidSansMono

source.verification: Byte copy of data/fonts/DroidSansMono.ttf and data/fonts/NOTICE at AOSP platform/frameworks/base tag android-4.4_r1, fetched 2026-11-25 through the gitiles ?format=TEXT endpoint (base64) and decoded. DroidSansMono is the Mono typeface of the UE 5.8 editor composite font (LegacySlateFontInfoCache.cpp lines 111-122); the copy UE ships (Engine/Content/Slate/Fonts/DroidSansMono.ttf, 78296 bytes) is a different revision than the AOSP file.
